passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.desc: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Thundering Smash
spells.desc: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

spells.name: Frenzied Maul
spells.desc: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

spells.name: Sky Splitter
spells.desc: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

spells.name: Stormbringer
spells.desc: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.
